fine_trace.note: In the FILE_USE case, the return value from match() is stored in rv, but the later comparison depends on rv being initialized on every path.
rv is declared as a local automatic variable without an explicit initializer, so control-flow paths that bypass assignment can leave it indeterminate.
The uninitialized rv is read here in the FILE_USE handling, which is the sink that triggers the MSan use-of-uninitialized-value report.
